name: Kickapoo River
gaugeName: KICKAPOO RIVER AT LA FARGE, WI
blurb: A winding Driftless river with short canoe trips through Wildcat Mountain State Park and Kickapoo Valley Reserve, plus longer sections downstream. Check dated river and shuttle notices before choosing a stretch.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

notices.title: Blockage reported before La Farge
notices.text: The reserve’s November 3 update reports a blockage between Bridge 19 and Landing 20 (Andrew’s Canoe Landing). This stretch crosses that reach. Do not assume a clear passage or a usable portage; check current conditions with the reserve and choose an upstream take-out if the obstruction remains. An access map does not confirm passage.

sections.routeReview: The arrival ends above Gays Mills Dam. The USGS candidate also retains an old river bend that differs from the visible channel, so its dotted path remains under review. Exact landing connections are not mapped.

notices.title: Take out above Gays Mills Dam
notices.text: Use the designated upstream takeout at Robb Park. The marker shows an approximate upstream park-bank area. Identify the signed landing while arranging your shuttle; the separate launch below the dam is not this trip’s destination.
notices.sourceName: Village of Gays Mills — Robb Park

sections.routeReview: This section includes Gays Mills and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

notices.title: Start below Gays Mills Dam
notices.text: The village identifies a canoe/kayak launch below the dam at Robb Park. Use the downstream launch for this trip to Steuben. The park marker is approximate; do not start above or paddle over the dam.
